title: Guild Member Robin Litwin Offers Encaustic Instruction
paragraphs: I have been loving encaustic painting for the past five years and want to thank Mary Moquin for helping me in countless ways; she is the most generous and gifted teacher and I cannot say enough about her. In the spirit of her teaching I want to pass on my knowledge and passion for this ancient medium. I am thrilled to be a new faculty member at the Creative Arts Center in Chatham and will be teaching a 2-day workshop there in June. I have done two demos at The Harwich Cultural Center, both fundraisers for The Family Pantry of Cape Cod, and they were awesome.
My upcoming workshops and classes are listed below. I am also available for one on one classes or small group classes at my studio in Harwich or at Local Color Gallery in Chatham.

bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder April 18, 2018

I have been loving encaustic painting for the past five years and want to thank Mary Moquin for helping me in countless ways; she is the most generous and gifted teacher and I cannot say enough about her. In the spirit of her teaching I want to pass on my knowledge and passion for this ancient medium. I am thrilled to be a new faculty member at the Creative Arts Center in Chatham and will be teaching a 2-day workshop there in June. I have done two demos at The Harwich Cultural Center, both fundraisers for The Family Pantry of Cape Cod, and they were awesome.

My upcoming workshops and classes are listed below. I am also available for one on one classes or small group classes at my studio in Harwich or at Local Color Gallery in Chatham.

Harwich Cultural Center, 204 Sisson Road, Harwich
Encaustic demo: Thursday, April 19th 12:30 – 3:30PM, $20 donation suggested
Encaustic demo: Thursday, May 3rd 12:00 – 2:00PM, Free admission part of ArtWeek schedule of events

Creative Arts Center, 154 Crowell Road, Chatham
Encaustic demo: Wednesday, May 23rd 10:30 – 12:30PM, Free admission, bring donation for Family Pantry of Cape Cod
Class: Intro to Encaustic Painting, Monday and Tuesday, June 18 & 19 9:30 – 1:00PM, $90 member $110 non member
